name: ky_search_businesses
description: Search the Kentucky Secretary of State Business Entity Search by entity name. Returns each entity's file_number (its organization number), name, status (e.g. A - Active, I - Inactive) and company type. Tolerant of case, punctuation, "&" vs "and" and the legal-form spelling (Inc / Incorporated, LLC / L.L.C.): each row carries match = exact | legal_form_variant | name_prefix, ranked in that order, and hits counts only the exact and legal_form_variant rows. The register returns at most 50 rows a page and this tool reads the first page; total_in_register says how many the register counted. Entity-level only: no individuals' names (registered agents and officers are not returned). Pass a row's file_number as org_number to ky_get_business for detail.

name.description: Entity name or the start of it, e.g. "Brown-Forman".

active_only.description: Only active entities. Default false (all statuses).

name: ky_get_business
description: Detail for one Kentucky Secretary of State business entity by its organization number (from ky_search_businesses): name, profit or non-profit, company type, status, standing, file date, organization date, last annual report, principal office address and how it is managed. Entity-level only: the registered agent and officers are not returned.
